title: Make live breadth stablecoin exclusion match its declared universe semantics
objective: Repair the existing CoinGecko Top100 breadth proxy so its declared STABLECOINS exclusion is deterministic and truthful. Reuse the already validated exact-stablecoin taxonomy principles from the 12 July frozen-universe research where applicable, add explicit taxonomy/version/limitation provenance, and prevent known stablecoins from entering the 100 eligible constituents. Preserve PROXY_ONLY / non-canonical authority and introduce no market threshold, source call, or portfolio semantics.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/data_terminal/a directly related small eligibility taxonomy helper if deduplication materially improves maintainability

evidence.summary: The owner advertises explicit_exclusions including STABLECOINS but implements only a small hard-coded symbol set that omits known stablecoins such as USD1, USDG, RLUSD and GHO.

The only stablecoin exclusion fixture changes one row to USDT; it does not test current stablecoin taxonomy coverage or semantic consistency between declared exclusions and actual eligible constituents.

Current 100-constituent live proxy includes USD1 (filtered rank 19), Global Dollar/USDG (22), Ripple USD/RLUSD (35) and GHO (80), even though all are exact stablecoin symbols present in the validated 12 July historical taxonomy.
The validated historical breadth program used exact stablecoin tags and symbols rather than broad protocol tags; this is an existing taxonomy principle, not a new market rule.
Validated taxonomy explicitly contains GHO, RLUSD, USD1 and USDG and distinguishes stablecoins from volatile stablecoin-protocol tokens.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect STABLE_SYMBOLS and the 2026-08-30 breadth owner snapshot. Confirm USD1, USDG, RLUSD and GHO are absent from STABLE_SYMBOLS but present among constituents while universe.explicit_exclusions claims STABLECOINS. Confirm the historical validated taxonomy recognizes those exact symbols. If current main already excludes them and reports an explicit deterministic taxonomy basis, stop as clean no-op.

positive: Fixtures containing USD1, USDG, RLUSD and GHO in the raw ranked set exclude each with an explicit stablecoin exclusion reason and still fill 100 eligible constituents from deeper ranked rows.
The owner exposes a deterministic exclusion taxonomy identifier/version or equivalent provenance so consumers can audit what STABLECOINS means for this proxy.
The live owner remains PROXY_ONLY, canonical_compatible=false and non-binding before and after the repair.

The existing known-good USDT exclusion test continues to pass, and a fixture for a volatile non-stable asset is not falsely excluded merely because its project/category is associated with stablecoins.
negative: Do not add an external API call, CoinGecko category call, new provider, or API budget.
Do not change breadth market thresholds, weights, adaptive cadence triggers, entry permission, canonical compatibility, or portfolio logic.
Do not infer or backfill historical constituent eligibility where the original snapshot lacks deterministic taxonomy evidence.

Do not broaden the fix to tokenized treasuries, commodity proxies, wrapped/LST assets, BTC or ETH unless the current live proxy explicitly claims those exclusions or an existing owner contract already requires them; ambiguous classes remain explicit limitations rather than guessed exclusions.
Do not create a second breadth owner or a new market engine.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already excludes the verified current stablecoin examples and reports a deterministic truthful exclusion-taxonomy basis without authority changes.
stop_condition: Stop if the live proxy intentionally includes stablecoins under a newer explicit canonical owner that supersedes its current STABLECOINS exclusion claim; otherwise preserve current proxy authority and repair the inconsistency.
escalation_condition: Escalate only if a complete stablecoin exclusion would require additional source calls or a policy decision beyond reusing already validated exact taxonomy principles.
